role: wild-type reference (full-length monomer, contains C-terminal HhH-GPD glycosylase domain ~426-580)
af3_substitution_note: AF2 monomer_ptm used; AlphaFold3 unavailable on cluster (disclosed).
caveat: Modeling confidence only (pLDDT/pTM); NOT experimental/functional/clinical validation. RUO.
interpretation: Full-length MBD4 WT (580 aa). Global mean pLDDT is low (56.8) ONLY because of the large intrinsically disordered central linker (~150-425, pLDDT ~35). Functional domains fold at high confidence: MBD (68-147, ~76) and the C-terminal HhH-GPD DNA-glycosylase catalytic domain (426-580, ~94). That catalytic domain is exactly the region ablated by p.K431Nfs*54 (product ends ~489 aa) -> clean structural basis for the CrisPRO 'BER -> non-functional' call.

central_linker_150_425.note: intrinsically disordered; dominates low global mean

HhH_GPD_glycosylase_426_580.note: catalytic domain; HIGH confidence; region ablated by K431Nfs*54
